note: Routes the census could not limit within its cap. Medium and Low are accepted for the date shown; Critical and High can never be accepted (fix the route).

decisions.rationale: Provider callback, deliberately not throttled so a burst of real provider traffic is never dropped. It is rejected cheaply before any work unless the provider signature or secret in the path checks out (401/403/404 in the census).

Verifies a signed Clerk token; a forged token fails signature verification. The route returns 404 when Clerk is not configured.

Capped silently per address and per account in the service; the forgot-password-mail-flood probe sent 60 requests for one account from 31 addresses and exactly 1 mail was issued, with the same neutral reply every time.
Ends a session from a token the caller already holds and always answers ok; nothing to guess and no side effect without a valid token.
